title: The intrinsic piezoelectricity of monoclinic Pb(Zr1−xTix)O3
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,38245-38252
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA06270A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Junyu Niu, Chong Li, Zengzhe Xi
The Cm(MB) structure of PZT was confirmed by DFT as a stable phase via phonon and covalent bonding analysis. Given its lower piezoelectric, the intrinsic piezoelectricity of low-symmetry phase was confirmed not the major contributor to MPB effect.
